subject: integration
name: Address list standard (ADDRESS_LIST_0_1)
summary: Defines what an installed Address list tells the wallet: the path template it derives addresses at, or up to 100 addresses it only shows. Only the browser's wallet calls it. A deriving list never receives a derived address or a key, and both functions are declared with no effect beyond answering. The row runs nothing, connects to nothing and names no list. Nothing here checks that a list that only shows addresses shows ones the person holds; that list is judged on its own row. Level 4 with privacy: a pure definition. Judged here by its publisher.
